title: ARM machines generally use ttyAMA0 for consoles. Instead of using "console=tty1 console=ttyS0" the CPC images should use "console=ttyAMA0 console=ttyS0"
commit_message: ARM machines generally use ttyAMA0 for consoles. Instead of using "console=tty1 console=ttyS0" the CPC images should use "console=ttyAMA0 console=ttyS0"
diff:
diff --git a/live-build/ubuntu-cpc/hooks.d/chroot/999-cpc-fixes.chroot b/live-build/ubuntu-cpc/hooks.d/chroot/999-cpc-fixes.chroot
index 3071e01..8f8ce24 100755
--- a/live-build/ubuntu-cpc/hooks.d/chroot/999-cpc-fixes.chroot
+++ b/live-build/ubuntu-cpc/hooks.d/chroot/999-cpc-fixes.chroot
@@ -187,10 +187,17 @@ fi
 psuedo_grub_probe > "${gprobe}"
 chmod 755 "${gprobe}"
 
+# arm uses ttyAMA0 for virtual consoles
+console="console=tty1 console=ttyS0"
+if [[ "${arch}" =~ (aarch64|arm) ]]; then
+        console="console=ttyAMA0 console=ttyS0"
+fi
+
 # for Quantal and later, use /etc/default/grub.d functionality
 # rather than modifying the grub configuration itself.
 # This avoids the mess of having to do dpkg stuff
 # LP: 1179940
+
 mkdir -p "${rootd}/etc/default/grub.d"
 cat << EOF > "${rootd}/etc/default/grub.d/50-cloudimg-settings.cfg"
 # Cloud Image specific Grub settings for Generic Cloud Images
@@ -203,7 +210,7 @@ GRUB_RECORDFAIL_TIMEOUT=0
 GRUB_TIMEOUT=0
 
 # Set the default commandline
-GRUB_CMDLINE_LINUX_DEFAULT="console=tty1 console=ttyS0"
+GRUB_CMDLINE_LINUX_DEFAULT="${console}"
 
 # Set the grub console type
 GRUB_TERMINAL=console
